title: Onset
description: A rhythm machine for walking through every 16th-note pattern by rule, with twelve unpitched sounds, an emphasis layer, hearts and MIDI export.

title: Cadence
description: A chord machine for exploring key-relative progressions: circle of 4ths and 5ths, jazz substitutions, every possible chord, with inversion and density controls.

title: Pairing
description: Loads the histories from Onset and Cadence and plays rhythms against progressions, giving more turns to the ones with more hearts.
